Documentation / Overview

France E-Invoicing API

ClearTax is a certified Plateforme Agréée (PA) for the French e-invoicing mandate. This documentation covers the Send and Receive APIs for France e-invoicing.

Methods and Endpoints

MethodEndpointDescriptionStatus
Send Flow
POST/einvoice/v1/documents/sendSubmit one or more invoice documents for validation and routing to the buyer via Peppol.Available
GET/einvoice/v1/documents/{document_id}/statusGet current lifecycle status of a document.Available
GET/einvoice/v1/documents/printGet the PDF version of an e-invoice based on the invoice identifiers.Coming soon
POST/einvoice/v1/documents/emailSend an e-invoice to the buyer via email.Coming soon
Receive Flow
GET/einvoice/v1/documents/queryRetrieve a list of purchase e-invoice documents filtered by date range, type, and pagination.Available
GET/einvoice/v1/documentsRetrieve full invoice payload by document ID or document number.Available

Validations

ClearTax validates every invoice before submission against ClearTax platform rules, France-specific Schematron rules (BR-FR), and Peppol business rules. Details can be found in the Validations and Error Messages pages.

Authentication

All requests must include a valid auth token. Country-specific headers are documented in the Send e-Invoice section.

HeaderTypeRequiredDescription

Content-TypeStringMandatoryMust be application/json

Productionhttps://api.fr.cleartax.comUnder Development
SEND FLOW

Send e-Invoice

POST/einvoice/v1/documents/send

Submit one or more invoice documents for validation and routing. ClearTax validates, transforms to UBL, files with PPF, and delivers via Peppol.

Submission Flow

Request Headers

HeaderTypeRequiredValue / Description
x-cleartax-auth-tokenStringMandatoryYour workspace auth token
x-clear-country-codeEnumMandatoryFR
x-einvoice-typeEnumMandatorySALES for outbound invoices
x-clear-sirenStringMandatorySeller's 9-digit SIREN. e.g. 732829320
x-clear-siretStringMandatorySeller's 14-digit SIRET
Content-TypeStringMandatoryapplication/json

Request Body

The request body wraps one or more documents. The invoice data is Base64-encoded JSON inside documentData.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
documentsArrayMandatoryList of invoice documents.
documents[].documentDataStringMandatoryBase64-encoded JSON of the invoice object.
JSON
{
  "documents": [
    {
      "documentData": "eyJpZCI6IklOVi0wMDEiLC4uLn0="
    }
  ]
}

Request Schema

The invoice JSON payload contains 453 fields organised into 16 groups. Fields marked 1..1 or 1..n are mandatory; 0..1 or 0..n are optional.

Sample Response

HTTP Status Codes

HTTP Status CodeDescription
200For successfully submitted document or with validation errors
400For any kind of Invalid Payload issues
401If the user is not authenticated for the operation
403If the user is not authorized for the operation
406Indicates failure in parsing of payload, e.g. due to invalid value for a field
429Rate limit exceeded
5xxInternal exception

Response Schema

ParameterData TypeDescription
SuccessBooleanAlways present. Indicates the request was successful or not.
DocumentResponsesArrayList of document response objects corresponding to documents in request.

Document Response Object

ParameterData TypeDescription
DocumentIdStringUnique document ID, generated by database. To be used in Status Check API.
UniqueIdStringUnique ID generated by ClearTax to distinctly identify the document.
SuccessBooleanIndicates, if the request for this document was successfully processed or not.
ErrorDetailsArrayOptional. Error list from ClearTax.
WarningDetailsArrayOptional. Warning list from ClearTax.

Error Details Object

ParameterData TypeField ValidationsDescription
ErrorCodeStringCannot be nullA code to identify the error.
ErrorMessageStringCannot be nullHuman readable error message.
ErrorSourceStringPossible values: CLEARTAX, VALIDATION_ERRORSource of the error.
PathStringIf it is a validation error of a request data, it will point to the request data.

Warning Details Object

ParameterData TypeField ValidationsDescription
CodeStringCannot be nullA code to identify the warning.
MessageStringCannot be nullHuman readable warning message.

RECEIVE FLOW

Receive e-Invoice

GET/einvoice/v1/documents/query

ClearTax receives invoices from your suppliers via Peppol, validates and normalises them, and makes them available for you to pull into your system. ClearTax acts as your PA (C3) — handling format detection (UBL, CII, Factur-X), schema validation, and storage on your behalf.

Query Documents

Query purchase invoices received by ClearTax on your behalf. Returns a summary list (document ID, invoice number, status) filtered by date range. Use the Get Document endpoint to retrieve the full invoice payload.

Response Schema

The invoice data returned in the Receive flow uses the same PINT JSON field structure as the Send flow (453 fields across 16 groups). In the Receive context, “Mandatory” means the field will always be present; “Optional” means it may or may not be present depending on what the seller included. Refer to the Send Flow — Request Schema for the complete field reference.

Request Headers

HeaderTypeRequiredValue / Description
x-cleartax-auth-tokenStringMandatoryAuthentication token. Format: 1.{token_value}
x-clear-country-codeEnumMandatoryFR
x-clear-sirenStringMandatory9-digit SIREN of the buyer entity. e.g. 784671695
einvoice-typeEnumMandatoryPURCHASE

Query Parameters

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
einvoice-typeEnumMandatoryPURCHASE
start-dateDateMandatoryStart of date range. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. No maximum date range limit.
end-dateDateMandatoryEnd of date range. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. No maximum date range limit.
page-numberIntegerOptional0-based page index. Default: 0
page-sizeIntegerOptionalNumber of results per page. Default: 100

Sort order: Results sorted by documentId (by receivedTime for inbound documents).

Sample Request

curl
curl --location 'https://api.fr.cleartax.com/einvoice/v1/documents/query?einvoice-type=PURCHASE&start-date=2026-04-28&end-date=2026-04-30' \
--header 'x-clear-country-code: FR' \
--header 'x-clear-siren: 784671695' \
--header 'einvoice-type: PURCHASE' \
--header 'x-cleartax-auth-token: {your_auth_token}'

      "DocumentNumber": "INV-FR-2026-FULL-010",
      "Status": "ACKNOWLEDGED",

  "ErrorDetails": null,
  "PageNumber": 0,

Documents[].ErrorDetailsObjectError details if applicable. null when no errors.
ErrorDetailsObjectRequest-level error details. null on success.
PageNumberIntegerCurrent page index (0-based).
PageSizeIntegerNumber of documents returned in this page.

Get Document

Retrieve the full invoice payload by document ID or document number. Works for both SALES and PURCHASE documents.

GET /einvoice/v1/documents

Request Headers

HeaderTypeRequiredValue / Description
x-cleartax-auth-tokenStringMandatoryYour workspace auth token
x-clear-country-codeEnumMandatoryfr
x-clear-sirenStringMandatory9-digit SIREN. e.g. 602348716

Query Parameters

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
einvoice-typeEnumMandatorySALES or PURCHASE
document-idStringConditionalClearTax document ID. Required if document-number is not provided.
document-numberStringConditionalInvoice number. Required if document-id is not provided.

Sample Request

curl
curl --location 'https://api.fr.cleartax.com/einvoice/v1/documents?document-id=6a0478f0f3e6b82ade9cd2e7&einvoice-type=PURCHASE' \
--header 'x-clear-country-code: fr' \
--header 'x-clear-siren: 602348716' \
--header 'x-cleartax-auth-token: {your_auth_token}'

Get Status

Check the current lifecycle status of a document. Works for both SALES and PURCHASE documents.

GET /einvoice/v1/documents/{document_id}/status

Request Headers

HeaderTypeRequiredValue / Description
x-cleartax-auth-tokenStringMandatoryYour workspace auth token
x-clear-country-codeEnumMandatoryFR
x-clear-sirenStringMandatory9-digit SIREN. e.g. 328746599
x-einvoice-typeEnumMandatorySALES or PURCHASE

Path Parameters

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
document_idStringMandatoryClearTax document ID (from Query API DocumentId field)

Query Parameters

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
einvoice-typeEnumMandatorySALES or PURCHASE

curl
curl --location 'https://api.fr.cleartax.com/einvoice/v1/documents/6a0478c61274944f56dcf1d0/status?einvoice-type=SALES' \
--header 'x-clear-country-code: FR' \
--header 'x-einvoice-type: SALES' \
--header 'x-cleartax-auth-token: {your_auth_token}' \

Disputed207Buyer flagged a problemNo
Suspended208Buyer needs more documentsNo
Completed209Seller provided additional infoNo
Refused210Buyer permanently rejectedYes

Validations

ClearTax validates every invoice before submission. This includes ClearTax platform validations, France-specific Schematron rules (BR-FR), and Peppol business rules (PEPPOL-EN16931). See the Field Requirements section for field-level rules and the Error Messages page for the complete list of BR-coded Schematron checks.

Field Requirements

Field-level validation rules applied by ClearTax during invoice processing. These are extracted from the compliance template. 122 fields have specific validation rules.

Invoice Level Details

BT CodeField NamePathCardinalityValidation Rules
BT-1Invoice Numberinvoice.idMandatory1. Mandatory - Yes – every invoice must have an Invoice Number 2. Unique per supplier - Must not repeat across invoices from the same seller for the same Year 3. Chronological order recommended - Should reflect issuance order (e.g., INV-2025-001 → INV-2025-002) 4. Should be Alphanumeric characters (A-Z, a-z, 0-9 5. No spaces or special characters Avoid /, \, #, or symbols; use- hyphen ("-") sign "+"underscore (_)slash (/) 6. Must match legal records - Number must align with seller’s internal accounting and VAT records 7. Referenced in credit notes - Required for linking via Credit or Debit Notes when the same is issued 8. An Invoice MUST have an Invoice number with length less than 50 characters
BT-2Invoice Issue Dateinvoice.issueDateMandatoryYYYY-MM-DD
BT-3Invoice Type Codeinvoice.invoiceTypeCode.valueMandatoryAn Invoice shall have an Invoice type code (BT-3). Total transaction types = 16 (France e-invoicing document codes) Simple invoices → 4 types - 380, 389, 393, 501 Down payment invoices → 2 types - 386, 500 Amended invoices → 4 types - 384, 471, 472, 473 Credit notes → 6 types - 261, 262, 381, 396, 502, 503
BT-5Document Currency Codeinvoice.documentCurrencyCodeMandatoryAn Invoice shall have an Invoice currency code (BT-5). All currencyID attributes must have the same value as the Invoice currency code, except for amounts expected to be in Tax accounting currency. Tax currency code MUST be coded using ISO code list 4217 alpha-3
BT-23Profile IDinvoice.profileIDMandatory1.BR-FR-08: Billing Framework The authorized values for the Framework (Billing Method) are: B1: Submission of an invoice for goods S1: Submission of an invoice for services M1: Submission of a double invoice (delivery of goods and services that are not incidental to each other) B2: Submission of an invoice for goods already paid S2: Submission of an invoice for services already paid M2: Submission of a double invoice already paid B4: Submission of a final invoice (after down payment) for goods S4: Submission of a final invoice (after down payment) for services M4: Submission of a double final invoice (after down payment) S5: Submission of a service invoice by a subcontractor S6: Submission of a service invoice by a co-contractor B7: Submission of an invoice for goods that has been the subject of e-reporting (VAT already collected) S7: Submission of an invoice for services that has been the subject of e-reporting (VAT already collected) 2.BR-FR-CO-08: Final Invoice Billing Framework If the billing framework (BT-23) is: - B4: Final invoices (after down payment) for goods - S4: Final invoices (after down payment) for services - M4: Duplicate final invoices (after down payment) THEN the invoice type cannot be: - Down payment invoice (386) - Self-billed down payment invoice (500) - Down payment invoice credit note (503) 3.BR-FR-CO-09: Billing Frame Already Paid If the billing frame (BT-23) is: - B2: Submission of an invoice for goods already paid - S2: Submission of an invoice for services already paid - M2: Submission of a duplicate invoice already paid THEN - The amount already paid (BT-113) is equal to the total amount of the invoice including VAT (BT-112) - the net amount to pay (BT-115) is equal to 0 - the due date (BT-9) MUST indicate the date the invoice was paid
BT-24Customization IDinvoice.customizationIDMandatory[BR-01]-An Invoice shall have a Specification identifier (BT-24). e-invoicing e-reporting Invoice BR-FR-MAP-15: BT-24 MAPPING For flow 1, BT-24 must be equal to: urn.cpro.gouv.fr:1p0:einvoicingextract#Base for the START profile, without the lines urn.cpro.gouv.fr:1p0:einvoicingextract#Full for the full profile (TARGET)"
BT-25Linked Invoice Number for Credit/Debit Note /Correction Invoiceinvoice.billingReference[].additionalDocumentReference.idConditional MandatoryMust be reported in case of Credit note 1. Mandatory - Yes – every invoice must have an Invoice Number 2. Unique per supplier - Must not repeat across invoices from the same seller for the same Year 3. Chronological order recommended - Should reflect issuance order (e.g., INV-2025-001 → INV-2025-002) 4. Should be Alphanumeric characters (A-Z, a-z, 0-9 5. No spaces or special characters Avoid /, \, #, or symbols; use- hyphen (""-"") sign ""+""underscore (_)slash (/) 6. Must match legal records - Number must align with seller’s internal accounting and VAT records 7. Referenced in credit notes - Required for linking via Credit or Debit Notes when the same is issued 8. An Invoice MUST have an Invoice number with length less than 50 characters "
BT-26Linked Invoice Date for Credit/ Debit Note /Correction Invoiceinvoice.billingReference[].additionalDocumentReference.issueDateConditional MandatoryMust be reported in case of Credit note YYYY-MM-DD The year of a date MUST BE between 2000 and 2099 An Invoice shall have an Invoice issue date (BT-2).
EXT-FR-FE-02Type of previous invoiceinvoice.billingReference[].additionalDocumentReference.documentTypeCodeConditional MandatoryDocument Type= 16 (France e-invoicing document codes) Simple invoices → 4 types - 380, 389, 393, 501 Down payment invoices → 2 types - 386, 500 Amended invoices → 4 types - 384, 471, 472, 473 Credit notes → 6 types - 261, 262, 381, 396, 502, 503

Invoice level details

BT CodeField NamePathCardinalityValidation Rules
BT-6Tax Currency Codeinvoice.taxCurrencyCodeConditional Mandatory[BR-53]-If the VAT accounting currency code (BT-6) is present, then the Invoice total VAT amount in accounting currency (BT-111) shall be provided. All currencyID attributes must have the same value as the Invoice currency code, except for amounts expected to be in Tax accounting currency. Tax currency code MUST be coded using ISO code list 4217 alpha-3

Document Reference

BT CodeField NamePathCardinalityValidation Rules
BT-7Tax point dateinvoice.taxPointDateConditional MandatoryVAT due date (BT-7), which is not used like this in France, but as an event in BT-8, to indicate whether VAT is due on the invoice date or delivery date (VAT debit) or on the payment date (VAT on collection)/ BT-8 is mandatory only for service invoices for which the SELLER has opted for debits. Otherwise, it may or may not be present.
BT-8Tax point date codeinvoice.invoicePeriod.descriptionCodeConditional MandatoryVAT on debits, VAT is due when the corresponding amount is debited from the "customer" account. It is emphasized that the option to pay the tax based on debits cannot delay the tax due date. Value added tax point date (BT-7) and Value added tax point date code (BT-8) are mutually exclusive.
BT-12Contract Document Referenceinvoice.contractDocumentReferences[].id.valueOptionalContract reference (BT-12): necessary in particular for recurring services managed without purchase order number (fluids, telephony) Must be reportd if the Document type is 262 in BT-3
BT-13Purchase Order Referenceinvoice.orderReference.idOptionalA Purchase Order reference generated by the BUYER (BT-13): data often required for all purchasing processes that involve the generation of a Purchase Order, transmitted at the time of the order, and not after delivery or invoicing. As a reminder, pursuant to Article L. 441-9 of the French Commercial Code, the invoice must mention the purchase order number when it has been previously established by the buyer. If received before the invoice is made so it should be part of the Invoice as per French Commericla code
BT-18Invoiced object identifierinvoice.additionalDocumentReference[].idOptionalMultiple references allowed (BT-18 / BT-128) The document and line-level invoice object identifier can now occur multiple times. This supports situations where: -One invoice must refer to several prior documents, or -One line is linked to multiple previous documents. This is needed for advanced CTC workflows (e.g., corrective flows, sub-contracting, grouped operations)
BT-21Invoice note subject codeinvoice.notes[].value (subject code as prefix)Mandatory1. BR-FR-05 (Mandatory Notes) Every invoice must contain at least 3 specific notes: PMT → Fixed €40 late payment penalty (text in BT-22) PMD → Penalty for late payment (custom, per company rules) AAB → Discount or no-discount information These are compulsory and must always appear. 2. BR-FR-06 (Uniqueness Rule) The following subject codes must appear only once per invoice: PMT, PMD, AAB and TXD No duplicates allowed for these notes. 3. BR-FR-MAP-04 (Note Mapping for Transmission) Only PMT, PMD, AAB, and TXD need to be transmitted in Flow 1 or Flow 10.1 Mapping:TT-26 = BT-21 (note subject code) TT-27 = BT-22 (note text) Any other notes are optional in Flow 10/10.1. Keeps flows lean by focusing on required codes. 4. BR-FR-MAP-06 (Special TXD Case) If a note has: BT-21 = TXD BT-22 = "SINGLE_TAXI_MEMBER" Then in Flow 1 it must be transcoded to:"Member of a single taxable person" In summary (one-liners) BR-FR-05: Invoices must always have PMT, PMD, AAB notes. BR-FR-06: PMT, PMD, AAB, TXD must appear only once. BR-FR-MAP-04: Only PMT, PMD, AAB, TXD are required in Flows 1 & 10.1.
BT-22Invoice noteinvoice.notes[].valueMandatory1. BR-FR-05 (Mandatory Notes) Every invoice must contain at least 3 specific notes: PMT → Fixed €40 late payment penalty (text in BT-22) PMD → Penalty for late payment (custom, per company rules) AAB → Discount or no-discount information These are compulsory and must always appear. 2. BR-FR-06 (Uniqueness Rule) The following subject codes must appear only once per invoice: PMT, PMD, AAB and TXD No duplicates allowed for these notes. 3. BR-FR-MAP-04 (Note Mapping for Transmission) Only PMT, PMD, AAB, and TXD need to be transmitted in Flow 1 or Flow 10.1 Mapping:TT-26 = BT-21 (note subject code) TT-27 = BT-22 (note text) Any other notes are optional in Flow 10/10.1. Keeps flows lean by focusing on required codes. 4. BR-FR-MAP-06 (Special TXD Case) If a note has: BT-21 = TXD BT-22 = "SINGLE_TAXI_MEMBER" Then in Flow 1 it must be transcoded to:"Member of a single taxable person" In summary (one-liners) BR-FR-05: Invoices must always have PMT, PMD, AAB notes. BR-FR-06: PMT, PMD, AAB, TXD must appear only once. BR-FR-MAP-04: Only PMT, PMD, AAB, TXD are required in Flows 1 & 10.1.
BT-73Invoice Period Start Dateinvoice.invoicePeriod.startDateOptionalFor all subscription services or for end-of-year discounts for which it is necessary to specify a reference period. Used when the invoice covers a billing period (e.g., monthly subscription, rental, utility bills, telecom services). YYYY-MM-DD The year of a date MUST BE between 2000 and 2099 If Invoicing period (BG-14) is used, the Invoicing period start date (BT-73) or the Invoicing period end date (BT-74) shall be filled, or both. [BR-29]-If both Invoicing period start date (BT-73) and Invoicing period end date (BT-74) are given then the Invoicing period end date (BT-74) shall be later or equal to the Invoicing period start date (BT-73).
BT-74Invoice Period End Dateinvoice.invoicePeriod.endDateOptionalFor all subscription services or for end-of-year discounts for which it is necessary to specify a reference period. Used when the invoice covers a billing period (e.g., monthly subscription, rental, utility bills, telecom services). YYYY-MM-DD The year of a date MUST BE between 2000 and 2099 If Invoicing period (BG-14) is used, the Invoicing period start date (BT-73) or the Invoicing period end date (BT-74) shall be filled, or both. [BR-29]-If both Invoicing period start date (BT-73) and Invoicing period end date (BT-74) are given then the Invoicing period end date (BT-74) shall be later or equal to the Invoicing period start date (BT-73).
BT-122Supporting document referenceinvoice.additionalDocumentReference[].idConditional MandatoryWithin the supporting-documents group (IBG-24), this field is mandatory (1..1) for each document entry. It is an identifier of the supporting document. What to provide: A unique reference or identifier for each supporting document. Could be a code, number, registration, or other unique ID. Example: “DOC-2025-INV005-CERT1” Or “InspectionReport-IR-3456” If you attach a PDF of the delivery note, you might have “DN-12345” as the reference.
BT-123Supporting document descriptioninvoice.additionalDocumentReference[].documentDescriptionOptionalThis is optional (0..1). Provides a descriptive text for the supporting document. What to provide: A short human-readable description explaining what the document is. Example: “Third-party inspection certificate confirming delivered quantity and quality” “Timesheet approved by client for service project” “Delivery note issued by forwarder on 2025-10-15”
BT-124External document locationMISSING: AdditionalDocumentReferenceType has no attachment fieldOptionalOptional (0..1). It is the URL (Uniform Resource Locator) where the external document is located. In other words: if the supporting document is stored externally (rather than embedded), this is the link. What to provide: A valid web address or repository link where the invoice recipient can access the supporting document. Example: “https://documents.mycompany.eu/supportingDocs/InspectionReport-IR-3456.pdf”
BT-125Attached documentMISSING: AdditionalDocumentReferenceType has no attachment fieldOptionalThis field allows you to embed a supporting document directly inside the invoice payload as a binary object (e.g., PDF, image, certificate, XML), instead of referencing it using a URL (IBT-124). This is used when the supplier wants to attach a document physically with the invoice data, ensuring it always travels together and does not rely on external links.

Payment Details

BT CodeField NamePathCardinalityValidation Rules
BT-9Payment due dateinvoice.dueDateOptionalIf the invoice type is: - Deposit invoice (386) - Self-billed deposit invoice (500) (*), the deposit payment date must be completed if the deposit payment date is determined/known and is different from the issue date. The due date is sometimes automatically calculated by software based on the issue date. This is a business rule but cannot be controlled from an application perspective.
BT-20Payment Terms Descriptioninvoice.paymentTerms.noteOptional[BR-CO-25]-In case the Amount due for payment (BT-115) is positive, either the Payment due date (BT-9) or the Payment terms (BT-20) shall be present.
BT-81Payment means codeinvoice.paymentMeans.paymentMeansCode.valueMandatory[BR-49]-A Payment instruction (BG-16) shall specify the Payment means type code (BT-81). [BR-61]-If the Payment means type code (BT-81) means SEPA credit transfer, Local credit transfer or Non-SEPA international credit transfer, the Payment account identifier (BT-84) shall be present.
BT-84IBANinvoice.paymentMeans.payeeFinancialAccount.idMandatory[BR-50]-A Payment account identifier (BT-84) shall be present if Credit transfer (BG-17) information is provided in the Invoice. [BR-61]-If the Payment means type code (BT-81) means SEPA credit transfer, Local credit transfer or Non-SEPA international credit transfer, the Payment account identifier (BT-84) shall be present.
BT-113Prepayment Amountinvoice.legalMonetaryTotal.prepaidAmountConditional MandatoryAmount: this is a “Decimal” type with a maximum of 2 digits after the decimal point, without a thousand separator, and with the decimal separator. Example 10000.34
BT-114Payable Rounding Amountinvoice.legalMonetaryTotal.payableRoundingAmountConditional MandatoryAmount: this is a “Decimal” type with a maximum of 2 digits after the decimal point, without a thousand separator, and with the decimal separator. Example 10000.34
BT-115Payable Amountinvoice.legalMonetaryTotal.payableAmountMandatoryAmount: this is a “Decimal” type with a maximum of 2 digits after the decimal point, without a thousand separator, and with the decimal separator. Example 10000.34

Seller Details

BT CodeField NamePathCardinalityValidation Rules
BT-29bSeller ID (SIRET)invoice.accountingSupplierParty.party.partyIdentification[].id (SIRET)MandatorySIRET (SIREN + NIC = 14 digits) Establishment-level identifier You can have one SIRET (0009) + one ROUTING CODE (0224) CO-10 = No duplicate scheme IDs when using multiple party IDs. CO-11 = Only specific identifiers (SIRET, Routing Code, AU SIREN) are allowed as private party IDs, each tied to a fixed scheme ID. SIRET-SIREN Consistency - the first 9 digits of the SIRET number must correspond to the SIREN number and the SIRET number must be 14 digits long.
BT-29b-1Scheme identifier (SIRET)invoice.accountingSupplierParty.party.partyIdentification[].id.schemeIDAuto-populatedIt will always be 0009 for a SIRET
BT-29cSeller identifier (routing)invoice.accountingSupplierParty.party.partyIdentification[].id (routing)OptionalYou can have one SIRET (0009) + one ROUTING CODE (0224) CO-10 = No duplicate scheme IDs when using multiple party IDs. CO-11 = Only specific identifiers (SIRET, Routing Code, AU SIREN) are allowed as private party IDs, each tied to a fixed scheme ID.

Purpose: To indicate the previous invoice in a chain of invoices (not necessarily correction). → Used for sequencing or re-issuance (e.g., a replacement invoice, progressive billing, or corrected invoice in continuity). Example: If Invoice INV-2023-100 replaces an earlier version INV-2023-099 (same transaction, updated), then: EXT-FR-FE-136 = INV-2023-099.

EXT-FR-FE-138Previous invoice dateinvoice.invoiceLine[].billingReference[].additionalDocumentReference.issueDateOptional"In the ""Start"" path: - Corrective invoice: Field BT-25 (reference to a previous invoice) is mandatory. If the invoice type is: - Credit note: Field BT-25 (Reference to a previous invoice or contract number) is mandatory. If there are a set of invoices, the ""reference to a previous invoice"" field can be repeated multiple times (cardinality 1.n). In the ""Target"" path: - Corrective invoice: Fields BT-25 (reference to a previous invoice [only]) and BT-26 (date of the previous invoice [only]) are mandatory. If the invoice type is: - Credit note: Fields BT-25 (Reference to a previous invoice or contract number) and BT-26 (date of the previous invoice or contract) are mandatory. If there are a set of invoices, the ""reference to a previous invoice"" field can be repeated multiple times (cardinality 1.n). It is also possible to transmit this information at the invoice line level in the target path and outside of PDF submission. For example, if the invoice type is: - Amended invoice: The EXT-FR-FE-136 (reference to a previous invoice only) and EXT-FR-FE-138 (date of the previous invoice only) fields are mandatory. If the invoice type is: - Credit note: The EXT-FR-FE-136 (Reference to a previous invoice or contract number) and EXT-FR-FE-138 (date of the previous invoice or contract) fields are mandatory."

CodeDescription
1Instrument not defined

6A debit transaction made through the automated clearing house system.
7ACH demand debit reversal
8A request to reverse an ACH debit transaction to a demand deposit account.
9ACH demand credit reversal

11ACH demand credit

13ACH demand debit
14A debit transaction made through the ACH system to a demand deposit account.

39Cheque
40Payment by a pre-printed form on which instructions are given to an account holder (a bank or building society) to pay a stated sum to a named recipient.
41Banker's draft
42Issue of a banker's draft in payment of the funds.
43Certified banker's draft
44Cheque drawn by a bank on itself or its agent. A person who owes money to another buys the draft from a bank for cash and hands it to the creditor who need have no fear that it might be dishonoured.
45Bank cheque (issued by a banking or similar establishment)
46Payment by a pre-printed form, which has been completed by a financial institution, on which instructions are given to an account holder (a bank or building society) to pay a stated sum to a named recipient.
47Bill of exchange awaiting acceptance
48Bill drawn by the creditor on the debtor but not yet accepted by the debtor.
49Certified cheque
50Payment by a pre-printed form stamped with the paying bank's certification on which instructions are given to an account holder (a bank or building society) to pay a stated sum to a named recipient .
51Local cheque
52Indicates that the cheque is given local to the recipient.
53ACH demand corporate trade payment (CTP) debit
54A debit transaction made through the ACH system to a demand deposit account using the CTP payment format.

57ACH demand corporate trade exchange (CTX) debit

68A consumer credit transaction made through the ACH system to a demand deposit or savings account.

Transport Mode Codes (Extended)

CodeDescription
Transport mode not specifiedTransport mode has not been specified Notes: 1) This code can be used when the mode is not known or when information on it is not available at the time of issuing the document concerned.
Maritime transportTransport of goods and/or persons is by sea.
Rail transportTransport of goods and/or persons is by rail.
Road transportTransport of goods and/or persons is by road.
Air transportTransport of goods and/or persons is by air.
MailMethod to convey goods is by mail Notes: 1) This code is provided for practical reasons, despite the fact that mail is not a genuine mode of transport. In many countries, the value of merchandise exported and imported by mail is considerable, but the exporter or importer concerned would be unable to state by which mode postal items had been conveyed.
Multimodal transpoMethod to convey goods and/or persons is by multimodal transport. Notes: 1) This code is provided for practical reasons, despite the fact that multimodal transport is not a genuine mode of transport. It can be used when goods are carried by at least two different modes from a place at which the goods are taken in charge by a transport operator to a place designated for delivery, on the basis of one transport contract. (Operations of pick-up and delivery of goods carried out in the performance of a single mode of transport, as defined in such a contract, shall not be considered as multimodal transport).
Fixed transport installationTransport of item is via a fixed transport installation. Notes: 1) This code applies to installations for continuous transport such as pipelines, ropeways and electric power lines.
Inland water transportTransport of goods and/or persons is by inland water.
Transport mode not applicableThe mode of transport is not applicable.
